primary_meaning: burden-bearer or strong donkey that labors under loads (often linked to industrious service or voluntary servitude)

alternatives.meaning: men who understand the times and know what Israel ought to do (discernment of seasons/strategy)
rejoicing in tents; calling peoples to the mountain for sacrifice; drawing abundance from seas and sand

notes: Jacob's oracle in Gen 49 supplies the dominant traditional tribal emblem in Christian exposition of the twelve tribes; the Chronicles notice is widely preached in modern teaching but is not the primary symbolic assignment across historic interpretation. No single meaning is universally fixed.
